wiki.title: Jim Piwowarczyk
wiki.extract: James M. Piwowarczyk II (born June 22, 1970) is an American realtor, Republican politician, and former law enforcement officer from Washington County, Wisconsin. He is a member of the Wisconsin State Assembly, and represents Wisconsin's 98th Assembly district in the 2025–2026 term. He is also a co-founder and editor of the conservative news website Wisconsin Right Now.
